ranking.why: Microsoft's own documentation says the integration uses EWS, stopped accepting new tenants/updates, recommends migration or temporary allow-listing, and ends support April 1 2027. Loss of EWS can break email, appointments, contacts, tasks and CRM-driven workflows. Riva and Synoptek already market Graph-based alternatives/assessments, proving budget and demand.
ranking.best_offer: Fixed-price EWS Exposure Assessment followed by optional Graph Sync Continuity Layer
ranking.buyer: IT director / Dynamics partner / MSP / CRM owner
ranking.acquisition: Dynamics partners, MSPs, public migration content, organizations advertising CRM on-prem expertise
ranking.risk: Strong competition and heterogeneous customizations; avoid building a full generic CRM sync product before a paid assessment.

ranking.why: Access OneOffice/DPS publicly warns customers that its OAuth connection to Exchange Online still uses EWS and requires tenant action before October. Professional-services firms have high dependence on email/calendar and high switching costs.
ranking.best_offer: EWS dependency audit + migration/continuity sprint for practice-management integrations
ranking.buyer: IT manager / software partner / professional-services firm
ranking.risk: Need exact per-product API surface and vendor cooperation.

ranking.why: Multiple vendors still have Exchange Online customers on EWS, but many already provide Graph migration paths. Strong installed-base opportunity but weaker moat for a standalone bridge.
ranking.best_offer: Migration kit / implementation service for legacy versions and hardware fleets
ranking.buyer: workplace IT / AV integrator / vendor partner
ranking.risk: Vendor-specific versions and existing Graph upgrades reduce addressable pain.

ranking.best_offer: Migration assistance for firms with complex tenant/security constraints
ranking.risk: Vendor-led migration may absorb most demand.

next_action: Do not launch a website. Validate the #1 vertical by enumerating 10-20 Dynamics CRM on-premises partners/MSPs that publicly discuss the EWS deadline or support CRM 9.x + Exchange Online. If at least 5 are reachable and do not already sell a complete Graph continuity solution, package a fixed-price assessment before writing production code.
